The best Banh mi in the Old Quarter of Hanoi
Aug 2026 • Family
The best Banh mi in the Old Quarter of Hanoi. Unbeatable value for money. Pork Banh mi (my favorites), chicken, and beef. Takeout or dine-in (usually a 20-minute wait) to get seats in the small room across the street. The smoothies are incredible; the avocado one is my favorite. An institution in Hanoi, but it is always packed at any time of day.

Bánh Mì That Does Not Disappoint!
Aug 2026 • Couples
Tried their signature Bánh Mì with pâté, barbecued pork, and smoked sausage, and it was delicious with such generous filling! The Bánh Mì Chảo (combo pan) was even better. The pâté, pork, sausage, and egg were so savory, and that sausage was seriously drool-worthy. It also comes with two pieces of bread for dipping.

Everything was so good I ended up getting another Bánh Mì to go. The iced coconut coffee, though, wasn’t for me. Their version is much heavier on the coconut than the coffee.

There can be a short queue during peak hours, but it’s manageable. The location is easy to find, with takeaway on one side of the street and the dine-in area directly across.

Overrated Banh Mi spot
Jun 2026 • Friends
This Banh Mi place doesn’t quite live up to the hype. We went out of our way to try them, but both the signature pork belly and chicken sandwiches were pretty bland, with not enough meat and nothing really special about them. They’re pretty basic sandwiches that lack any standout features or that "wow" factor. 

The seating was a bit confusing; we ended up at a small table next to the stall because the main area was packed, and a sign would’ve helped point us in the right direction. We feel other local Banh Mi spots in the Old Quarter deliver better taste and quality. There's no need to waste your time here — it just doesn’t offer anything memorable.
